manifest.labels: Codex source-aware authored before this experiment; no independent human review
manifest.input_policy: All 50 old customer turns. Only prior CUSTOMER utterances; no historical assistant, facts, proposed goals or Gold in requests. Candidate quote splitting fixed offline, not evaluating the planner.
manifest.boundary_policy: Q23-T1 primary gold UNCLEAR fixed before inference; also report predeclared 49-case sensitivity excluding this ambiguous item, never replace the main 50-case denominator.
manifest.cost_policy: USD estimates at uniform peak cache-miss .3 input/1.2 output per M for Flash; Jev .042 input per M/output free. Not an invoice. Preserve vendor cache usage separately.
